sentences.text: Thanks for making time. The goal today is to agree the scope of the Underwriting Copilot pilot.
Our analysts spend about two days per small business file pulling numbers out of tax returns and bank statements. We want that under half a day.
Credit risk needs every extracted figure to point back to the page it came from. Without that the committee will not accept it.
That matches how we built it. Every field carries a citation to the source page.
Which loan types do you want to start with?
SBA files are the most uniform, so the error rate will be easiest to measure.
Decision: the pilot starts with SBA 7(a) loan files only, commercial real estate later.
I can pull a sample of forty anonymized files. We strip borrower names before anything leaves our system.
Good. Sam will stand up the Data Room Ingest pipeline on our side so the files land in a separate tenant.
Let's review results in five weeks.

summary.action_items:
- [ ] Jen to share 40 anonymized SBA loan files by 2026-09-15
- [ ] Sam to set up the Data Room Ingest tenant for Copperline by 2026-09-12
- [ ] Lena to draft the pilot success metrics by 2026-09-11
